title: Delete account
intent: Delete {Account|address} and send all of its remaining XRP to {Destination|account}.

risks.message: Deletes this account and sends everything it holds in XRP to {Destination|address}. This cannot be undone.
{Destination|address} is not in the verified registry. Check the full address before sending the account's whole balance there.
{Destination|account} requires a destination tag; funds sent without one may be lost or delayed.
